label: Bible Study
prompt: And out of the ground made the LORD God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of _____ also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.
verse: And out of the ground made the LORD God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.
note: Eden had two famous trees in the middle — this one, and the one that caused all the trouble.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Let the sea _____, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that is therein.
verse: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that is therein.
note: Even the sea gets a part in David's praise song: let the sea roar.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he asked for a writing _____, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.
verse: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.
note: Struck mute, Zacharias asked for a 'writing table' — a tablet — to settle his son's name once and for all: John.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Is not this the _____ that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?
verse: Is not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?
note: Israel fasted and complained God didn't notice; he replied that the fast he wants is freeing the oppressed.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Who is this that _____ counsel by words without knowledge?
verse: Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge?
note: God finally answers Job out of the whirlwind, and opens with a question: 'Who is this that darkeneth counsel?'
